subject: POC MAP and onboarding checklist — API keys, org seed, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Sera Cho <sera@helionhealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: helion-infra@helionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP items we need to lock down

Mateo / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Helion's leadership wants a tight mutual action plan so we can close toward a pilot by end of October. To make the internal procurement and network teams happy I need a concrete checklist from RWI covering: org seed and admin invite flow, API key provisioning (non-prod and prod-test), the IP allowlist format you need, and the VPC peering steps (who initiates, CIDR expectations, time required).

I've attached our security questionnaire sheet with a few items filled in — please annotate it where you can. Also cc'd our infra alias so they have visibility. Can you confirm whether Redwood can generate ephemeral keys for the POC, or if we need to rotate long-lived keys manually?

Key dates: Helion wants to open the VPC peering request on 2027-10-10; procurement needs final MAP by 2027-10-07 to attach to the SOW.

Appreciate a concise checklist and suggested schedule.

— Sera

Attachments: Helion_Security_QA.xlsx

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sera Cho <sera@helionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, helion-infra@helionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 16:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP items we need to lock down

Sera — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the QA sheet. I've sketched a short MAP below that covers exactly the items you listed and aligns to the dates you proposed. I've also attached a one-page MAP PDF and a small CSV template for VPC CIDRs.

Summary (high level)
- Target pilot window: 2027-10-18 to 2027-10-31
- Procurement deadline (MAP finalized): 2027-10-07
- VPC peering request window: Helion submits 2027-10-10, RWI accepts 2027-10-11 (subject to CIDR validation)

Mutual Action Plan (POC onboarding) — owners & asks
1) Org bootstrap and admin invites (owner: Helion / contact: Sera) — Due 2027-10-07
   - We will provide a tenant seed link (one-click org creation) and a short admin on-boarding checklist.
   - Required from Helion: primary admin email, desired team name, and SSO preference if you want one-time SSO set up for sandbox.

2) API keys & environment separation (owner: Redwood / contact: Mateo) — Due 2027-10-08
   - Deliverables: non-prod API key, prod-test API key, sample SDK config. Keys will be labeled: helion-sandbox-<date>, helion-prodtest-<date>.
   - Ephemeral keys: Redwood supports a short-lived API key flow for POC traffic (recommended). We can enable rotating ephemeral tokens TTL=4h for the sandbox. If you require long-lived keys we can issue them with manual rotation guidance.

3) IP allowlist and network connectivity (owner: Helion infra / contact: helion-infra@helionhealth.com) — Due 2027-10-09
   - RWI needs a list of egress IPs (CIDR or single IP per line) in CSV format. See attached vpc-peering-cidr-template.csv.
   - If using NAT/gateway, include public egress ranges and any intermediate firewall rules that will affect 443 outbound.

4) VPC peering (owner: joint) — Peering request by Helion 2027-10-10; expected accept by RWI 2027-10-11
   - Steps: Helion opens peering request (include Helion VPC ID, preferred peering name, CIDR ranges for your VPC and the RWI stub ranges in template). RWI will validate CIDR non-overlap and return BGP/route instructions if applicable.
   - Maintenance window: peering creation itself is low-impact; initial routing validation and firewall check may require a 30–60 minute window.

5) Security & audits (owner: Helion and RWI security) — Ongoing
   - RWI will supply SOC 2 Type II summary and our standard data handling appendix. For anything deeper we can exchange a more detailed evidence packet (we can pre-fill portions of your QA sheet — see attached RWI_MAP_for_Helion_v1.pdf).

Action items for this thread (short):
- Mateo: attach MAP PDF and CIDR template (sent) — DONE
- Sera / Helion infra: send CSV with egress IP ranges by 2027-10-09
- Helion procurement: confirm MAP sign-off by 2027-10-07 (DocuSign link below)

Notes on keys & security
- For the pilot we recommend ephemeral tokens for the sandbox. If your testing harness requires long-lived keys we will issue with recommended rotation cadence and an automated reminder.
- Audit logging: token-level request traces are available in the Redwood Console for the tenant; we can grant Helion read-only views for debugging during POC.

Doc links & signatures
- MAP draft (attached): RWI_MAP_for_Helion_v1.pdf
- VPC CIDR template (attached): vpc-peering-cidr-template.csv
- DocuSign MSA & SOW: https://app.docusign.com/abcd1234/Helion-MSA
- Collaborative MAP doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bRWI-Helion-MAP

If this looks good I'll lock the dates and send the DocuSign package for procurement to attach to the SOW. If you prefer, we can push the peering by 48 hours but procurement timeline will slip.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a short checklist email to the infra team once I see the CSV.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: RWI_MAP_for_Helion_v1.pdf, vpc-peering-cidr-template.csv

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, Sera Cho <sera@helionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, helion-infra@helionhealth.com
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 02:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP items we need to lock down

Adding a quick operations note from Redwood's side — two small clarifications so Helion infra can prepare: 

1) RWI egress/peering ranges: the template has our expected stub ranges but we will accept a single /32 per NAT gateway if that's easier for you; please include the public IPs that will be used for outbound to Redwood if you sit behind a NAT.

2) Ephemeral key enablement: we can enable TTL-based ephemeral tokens for your sandbox tenant immediately after org bootstrap. Those tokens require a short auth handshake (we can provide the sample client code). If you want rotation built into your CI we can set up a short runbook with secrets rotation and a webhook to notify on expiry.

3) SOC 2 evidence: we've attached the MAP PDF with a short appendix that references our SOC 2 attestation and where to find the artifacts. For procurement, a single line in the SOW referencing "SOC 2 Type II summary provided by Redwood" is usually sufficient; if procurement asks for the full report we can route a secure transfer.

Sera — next step from your infra team: send the CIDR list and the preferred peering window (we suggested 10/10) and we'll mark acceptance available on 10/11 pending validation.

I'll stand by to approve the DocuSign when Mateo sends.

— Kimberly
Director, Platform Ops — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
